name: Order Status Conditional Notification
description: Fetches an order and routes execution to different notification endpoints based on the order status.
expected_documentation:
# Order Status Conditional Notification

## Overview
Looks up an order by ID and notifies the right downstream endpoint depending on whether the order failed.

## Prerequisites
None. The workflow calls api.example.com and hooks.example.com with no connections or secrets.

## Trigger
Manual Trigger — started by a user; expects an `orderId` in the input data.

## Walkthrough
1. Start (Manual Trigger) receives `orderId`.
2. Look Up Order (HTTP Request) GETs the order from the orders API, interpolating `{{trigger.data.orderId}}` into the URL.
3. Order Failed? (Conditional) evaluates whether the looked-up status equals "failed".
4. On true, Alert Failure (HTTP Request) POSTs to the failure webhook; on false, Log Success (HTTP Request) POSTs to the success log.

## Data Flow
The trigger's `orderId` flows into the lookup URL and both webhook bodies; the lookup's `status` field drives the branch.

## Decisions
Order Failed?: when `{{steps.lookup.body.status}} == "failed"` the run takes the true path to Alert Failure, otherwise the false path to Log Success.

## Error Handling
None configured: a missing `orderId` breaks URL interpolation, and a malformed condition raises a node error.
